content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-17: A new limb lies across the lower path, leaves still bright, with beetles underneath and wet seeds caught in the bark seams. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY worked around the fallen limb, found beetles in the underside bark, and made a new notch-route over it.
content.branch_b_path: YY named the limb in Mira ledger as a new path feature and showed three smaller squirrels the notch-route.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
